title: Google Launched Gemini Omni - Creates Anything From Any Input
description:
Google just launched Gemini Omni, their new multimodal AI model rolling out right now. Drop in any mix of text, images, audio, or video and it understands all of it, then generates high quality videos with real motion and visuals grounded in real world knowledge. All output is fully editable. Comment "Omni" and I'll DM you the link to try it.
#GeminiOmni #Google #AINews #AIVideo #Gemini
